title: V1 Acceptance MEDIUM R2 — telemetry terminal-state conflict hardening
description: Stage C Test 2 R2 legitimate governance-data integrity hardening. Reject contradictory canonical terminal outcomes when the same task telemetry contains both MERGED and ABORTED, while preserving repeated identical terminal outcomes, explicit provenance, deterministic aggregation, persistence and verified readback.

external_gate_evidence.rule: Stage C Test 2 R2 must classify MEDIUM from the telemetry-governance paths/rule itself. Deterministic Review is provider-derived from GitHub Actions Check Runs only; executor-authored REVIEW/VERIFICATION comment gates are prohibited. Exact-artifact ACTIVE LOCK is required after provider checks pass. Human Gate is not required unless effective risk escalates to HIGH.

acceptance_criteria.description: A telemetry record containing both canonical terminal outcomes MERGED and ABORTED fails closed with CONFLICTING_TERMINAL_STATES independent of event ordering.
Repeated identical canonical terminal outcomes remain valid and deterministic, including normalized case variants, without changing calibration eligibility semantics.
Existing terminal-state validation, explicit provenance, budget aggregation, persistence integrity and verified readback behavior remain intact.
The artifact changes exactly the five authorized telemetry/governance paths and does not mutate product runtime, APIs, database, dependencies, workflows, protection or risk/scope/merge controllers.
Deterministic classification is MEDIUM from the telemetry task risk rule/changed paths with Human Gate not required; any escalation to HIGH fails closed.

Fresh exact-head verify, Phase A and merge-policy evidence plus exact-artifact ACTIVE LOCK are required before PRE_DISPATCH_GUARD; protected workflow_dispatch and exact-SHA postmerge verification remain mandatory for completion.
